name: Bosch Ltd
title: Bosch Ltd - 500530 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Bosch Ltd is buying related-party Bosch Chassis Systems (RBIC) for INR9,068.7 cr at 10.6x FY25 EV/EBITDA, all-cash, with ~5% pro forma EPS accretion; no quarterly results discussed, and no capacity or utilisation numbers given beyond "lines are full".

capex.quote: between 1.5% and 3.5% investment of the total net sales is what you also see in the business case

triggers.label: Acquisition INR9,068.7 cr at 10.6x EV/EBITDA
triggers.quote: The purchase consideration for the transaction is INR9,068.70 crores. RBIC's valuation is at an implied 10.6x EV over FY25 EBITDA.

triggers.label: Lines full, capacity nearing max
triggers.quote: The current capacity, I think we are on the verge of maxing out in the current location

triggers.label: Pro forma EPS accretion ~5%
triggers.quote: expected pro forma EPS accretion of approximately 5% based on FY25 numbers

triggers.label: Order book very full, 4-5 yr pipeline
triggers.quote: the current order book is very full. It's the market leader, very good market share across all categories

guidance.metric: Margins held steady for next ~5 years
guidance.quote: We believe we will hold margins very steady for the next 5 years or so.
expected pro forma EPS accretion of approximately 5% based on FY25 numbers
we target to complete the acquisition by the end of first quarter of FY27

red_flags.label: Related-party acquisition, all-cash, minimal minority participation
red_flags.quote: The purchase consideration for the transaction is INR9,068.70 crores.

red_flags.label: Governance: preferential issue disclosure criticised as opaque
red_flags.quote: I hope this falls under the right governance practice.

red_flags.label: Ongoing RPT with captive electronics supplier, low margin, capex heavy
red_flags.quote: it is a very, very low margin, very high capex intensive and it is a pure supplier to this.

evasions.quote: we generally do not disclose product segment wise details
The cash we would at this point of time not disclosed.
It is an UPSI matter for us.
we in general do not disclose KPIs on a segmental base
